manager.pricing.description: Edit prices and management fees for each product, tournament and Season Pass. Changes apply to new orders; existing orders keep their amount.
manager.pricing.defaultsHint: These prices apply when a tournament or season has no custom amount. Fees are added to the price; use €0 to waive them.
manager.pricing.tournamentsHint: Each tournament can have its own price and management fee. You can return to its category price for either field.
manager.pricing.seasonsHint: Set an amount for each season or use the general Season Pass price.
manager.pricing.invalidPrice: Enter a price from €0.01 to €100,000, with at most two decimal places.
manager.pricing.invalidFee: Enter a fee from €0 to €20, with at most two decimal places.
manager.pricing.invalidDraft: Check the marked amounts before publishing.
manager.pricing.unavailable: Price editing is not available in this environment yet. Update the backend and refresh.
manager.pricing.taxHint: Management fees are edited for each product, tournament and season under Prices and fees.
manager.pricing.pageDescription: Control what the public CTP website shows without deploying: sections, clubs, tournaments, calendar, prices, management fees and payment VAT.
manager.images.invalid: Use a PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, BMP or AVIF photo that your browser can open.
manager.images.dimensions: Images support up to 24 megapixels and 12,000 pixels per side.
manager.images.sourceSize: The source image supports up to 12 MB.
manager.images.logoPng: The crest must be a PNG file with a transparent background.
manager.images.static: Use a static image for this asset.
manager.images.prepareError: The image could not be prepared.
manager.images.logoClear: The PNG must contain the crest and have a transparent background reaching its border. Backgrounds are not removed automatically.
manager.images.outputSize: The compressed image exceeds 2 MB. Try a smaller image.
manager.images.webpUnsupported: Your browser cannot create WebP. Update it or use another browser.
manager.images.logoHint: PNG with a transparent background. Up to 512 px, without enlargement.
manager.images.coverHint: Automatically converted to WebP and cropped centrally, up to 1600 × 600.
manager.images.photoHint: Photos are converted to WebP. GIF: first frame.
manager.images.uploadType: Select a transparent PNG crest or a photo converted to WebP for the banner. Maximum 2 MB.

manager.teamAdmins.unavailable: CTP could not be checked. Refresh before making changes.

manager.teamAdmins.accountUnavailable: The account must be confirmed, active and free of incompatible competitive membership.
manager.teamAdmins.notFound: The team or account was not found.
manager.teamAdmins.requestConflict: This request already has different details. Refresh before continuing.
manager.teamAdmins.reasonRequired: Provide a reason of at least 12 characters.
manager.teamAdmins.activeRoster: The account has active competition participation or incompatible membership. Its role was not changed.
manager.teamAdmins.limit: The team administrator limit has been reached.
manager.teamAdmins.captainRequired: The team needs someone in charge. Assign another administrator or the replacement captain before continuing.
manager.teamAdmins.writesDisabled: CTP changes are disabled in this environment.
manager.teamAdmins.invalidCreate: Choose an administrative manager or a playing captain, never both.
manager.teamAdmins.createDescription: Create a team with an existing account, without activating passes or adding players automatically.
manager.teamAdmins.createUnavailable: This CTP version does not yet support manual creation.
manager.teamAdmins.createAdminHelp: The administrator manages the team without taking a player slot. They may manage other teams with separate passes and rosters.

manager.teamAdmins.noManagedTeams: This account does not administer any teams yet.
manager.teamAdmins.directoryHelp: Find an account to review its teams, passes and registrations separately.
manager.teamAdmins.reasonHint: Required to assign or revoke access. At least 12 characters.
manager.teamAdmins.unchanged: The assignment already had that state.

manager.teamAdmins.independentAccess: Revoking administrative access does not delete teams, history, passes or points.
manager.teamAdmins.teamFilter: Showing only the selected team’s passes.
manager.teamAdmins.notAdministrativeYet: {name} is a playing captain. Conversion requires explicit confirmation.

manager.teamAdmins.noReplacementNeeded: They are the only member. The team will have no players until they join.
manager.teamAdmins.convertConfirm: I confirm this person will only administer and will no longer be a team player.
